f3_program: observe(at("shared_funds.amount", "initial"), 50, "currency", source("Tony, Moses and Esther are to share $50"))
transfer("moses_share", "moses", "shared_funds", "moses", at("moses.share.amount", "after_sharing"), source("Moses will take 40% of the total amount"))
transfer("tony_share", "tony", "shared_funds", "tony", at("tony.share.amount", "after_sharing"), source("Tony and Esther will split the remainder equally among themselves"))
transfer("esther_share", "esther", "shared_funds", "esther", at("esther.share.amount", "after_sharing"), source("Tony and Esther will split the remainder equally among themselves"))
percent_of(event_field("moses_share", "quantity"), at("shared_funds.amount", "initial"), 40, source("Moses will take 40% of the total amount"))

sum_relation(at("shared_funds.amount", "initial"), event_field("moses_share", "quantity"), event_field("tony_share", "quantity"), event_field("esther_share", "quantity"), source("Tony, Moses and Esther are to share $50"))
same(event_field("tony_share", "quantity"), event_field("esther_share", "quantity"), source("Tony and Esther will split the remainder equally among themselves"))
query("difference", event_field("esther_share", "quantity"), event_field("moses_share", "quantity"))
collection("grant.baby_teeth.fallen_out", "tooth", "grant", source("All 20 of Grant’s baby teeth have fallen out"))
observe(at("grant.baby_teeth.fallen_out.count", "current"), 20, "count", source("All 20 of Grant’s baby teeth have fallen out"))
observe(at("grant.tooth_fairy.receipts.total", "current"), 54, "currency", source("he has a total of $54 from the tooth fairy"))
transfer("place_under_pillow", "grant", "grant.baby_teeth.retained", "grant.pillow", "grant.baby_teeth.under_pillow.count", source("he put it under his pillow for the tooth fairy"))
remove("dropped_tooth", "grant", at("grant.baby_teeth.retained.count", "current"), 1, source("one that he dropped on the way home from school"))
consume("swallowed_tooth", "grant", at("grant.baby_teeth.retained.count", "current"), 1, source("another he swallowed accidentally"))

sum_relation(at("grant.baby_teeth.fallen_out.count", "current"), event_field("place_under_pillow", "quantity"), event_field("dropped_tooth", "quantity"), event_field("swallowed_tooth", "quantity"), source("Every time he lost a tooth, he put it under his pillow for the tooth fairy, except for one that he dropped on the way home from school and another he swallowed accidentally"))
observe(at("grant.tooth_fairy.receipts.first_tooth", "current"), 20, "currency", source("The tooth fairy left Grant $20 when he lost his first tooth"))

transfer("first_tooth_payment", "tooth_fairy", "tooth_fairy.money", "grant.money", at("grant.tooth_fairy.receipts.first_tooth", "current"), source("The tooth fairy left Grant $20 when he lost his first tooth"))
offset(at("grant.baby_teeth.under_pillow.after_first.count", "current"), event_field("place_under_pillow", "quantity"), -1, "count", source("after his first tooth"))
collection("grant.tooth_fairy.receipt_categories", "receipt_amount", "grant", source("a total of $54 from the tooth fairy"))
member("grant.tooth_fairy.receipt_categories", "grant.tooth_fairy.receipts.first_tooth", source("The tooth fairy left Grant $20 when he lost his first tooth"))
member("grant.tooth_fairy.receipt_categories", "grant.tooth_fairy.receipts.after_first.total", source("money exchanged for each tooth thereafter"))
partition("grant.tooth_fairy.receipt_categories", at("grant.tooth_fairy.receipts.total", "current"), source("a total of $54 from the tooth fairy"))

rate_relation(at("grant.tooth_fairy.receipts.after_first.total", "current"), at("grant.tooth_fairy.receipts.after_first.per_tooth", "current"), at("grant.baby_teeth.under_pillow.after_first.count", "current"), source("equal money exchanged for each tooth thereafter"))
query("value", at("grant.tooth_fairy.receipts.after_first.per_tooth", "current"))

assumptions: “At least once a week” does not determine an exact number of theater visits over six weeks.
